Follow-up to v0.1.78, from the first two joins on it.

## Server

### Fixed
- A player's saved record keeps its id across saves. The first join on v0.1.78 was clean, but the game's save path overwrites the whole record with the struct the client holds, and that struct carries the blank id it was handed while the swap was in place; after the first save the record read as a second blank record and the next join found the wrong one. Any record with a blank id whose inventory id is a known player's stable inventory id is that player's record and gets its id put back: at boot, before every save, before every swap, and every quarter second while no swap is in place. Log line: `saved record id repaired`.
